previous_statement: Splitting the barycenter identity sum_i p_i w_i = 0 over B and A, using w_i = w_* on B and q := sum_{i in B} p_i, gives q*w_* + sum_{i in A} p_i w_i = 0, hence -q*w_* = sum_{i in A} p_i w_i.
new_statement: Using node 1.1.2 that A is the complement of B in {1,...,m}, split the barycenter identity sum_i p_i w_i = 0 over the disjoint union B union A; since w_i = w_* on B and q := sum_{i in B} p_i, this gives q*w_* + sum_{i in A} p_i w_i = 0, hence -q*w_* = sum_{i in A} p_i w_i.
